ApiPhloCapabilities

Documentation / API / phlo / capabilities

Capability primitives and registry for Phlo.

This module provides the capability system that enables runtime feature discovery and dependency injection. Capabilities abstract concrete implementations of features like query engines, table stores, and authentication providers.

The capability system allows Phlo to:

  • Register and discover implementations at runtime
  • Resolve capabilities based on configuration and availability
  • Provide a unified interface for diverse backends
  • Support plugin-based extensibility

Key Concepts:

  • Capability: An abstract feature (e.g., "query_engine")
  • Provider: A concrete implementation (e.g., TrinoQueryEngine)
  • Specification: Configuration for a capability instance
  • Registry: Thread-safe storage for capability specifications
  • Resolution: Selecting the best available provider

Capability Types:

  • query_engine: SQL query execution (Trino, DuckDB, etc.)
  • table_store: Table storage (Iceberg, Delta, etc.)
  • catalog: Metadata catalog (Nessie, OpenMetadata, etc.)
  • object_store: Object storage (MinIO, S3, etc.)
  • authentication: User authentication providers
  • authorization: Policy-based access control
  • observability: Metrics and monitoring backends
  • alert_sink: Alert notification destinations
  • quality_backend: Data quality validation
  • schema_migrator: Schema evolution management
  • maintenance_read_model: Maintenance status tracking

Main Components:

  • :class:CapabilityRegistry: Thread-safe capability storage
  • :func:get_capability_registry: Access the global registry
  • :func:resolve_capability: Resolve a capability to a provider
  • :func:register_*: Functions to register capability implementations
  • :class:CapabilitySupport: Declare operational guarantees
  • :class:RuntimeContext: Context for capability resolution

Protocol for extracting a NormalizedSchema from a quality provider's native schema.

SchemaMigrator

Protocol for storage-layer schema migration providers.

Each storage provider (Iceberg, Delta, Hudi) implements this protocol and determines its own classification rules based on its capabilities.

supported_changes

Return the set of change_type values this provider supports natively.

classify_change

Classify a single change as 'safe', 'warning', or 'breaking'.

diff_schema

Compare desired schema against current table and produce a migration plan.

apply_plan

Execute a migration plan. Breaking changes require approved=True.

get_schema_history

Return schema version history for a table.

TableStore

Protocol for table-store providers used by ingestion components.

Required methods: ensure_table, append_parquet, merge_parquet. Extended operations (overwrite_parquet, delete_rows, compact, list_snapshots, rollback_to_snapshot, vacuum) raise NotImplementedError by default so providers opt in incrementally.

ensure_table

Ensure a destination table exists.

append_parquet

Append staged parquet data to a destination table.

merge_parquet

Merge staged parquet data into a destination table.

overwrite_parquet

Overwrite a table with staged parquet data.

delete_rows

Delete rows matching a predicate expression.

compact

Compact small files in a table.

list_snapshots

List recent table snapshots for time-travel queries.

rollback_to_snapshot

Roll back a table to a previous snapshot.

vacuum

Remove orphan files older than the retention period.

Submodules

  • authentication — Default authentication provider capability providers.
  • authorization — Default authorization policy backend capability provider.
  • authorization_opa — External OPA-backed authorization policy provider.
  • discovery — Capability discovery for asset and resource providers.
  • interfaces — Runtime capability interfaces used by capability providers.
  • maintenance — Default maintenance read-model implementation.
  • observability — Default observability capability provider.
  • registry — Capability registry for assets, checks, and resources.
  • resolver — Capability resolver for runtime provider selection.
  • runtime — Runtime context protocol and helpers for capability execution.
  • schema — Default schema change classification helper.
  • specs — Capability specs for orchestrator-agnostic assets and checks.
  • support — Structured capability support metadata.
  • telemetry — Core telemetry recording helpers.
